title: SprayerState
description: 2 Hz and on every change, on agri/v1/{robot_id}/sprayer/state. `interlocks` is the robot's own view of each precondition. The backend re-checks the same conditions before publishing a spray command, but the robot's copy is authoritative: it is the one attached to the valve.

armed.description: Arming requires an explicit operator confirm and auto-clears on disconnect or lease expiry.

interlocks.title: SprayerInterlocks
interlocks.description: Every one of these must be true for the valve to open. Reported individually so the UI can say exactly which one is blocking, rather than a bare refusal.

inside_geofence.description: Robot is inside the field polygon. Checked on the robot and again in PostGIS on the backend.

speed_ok.description: Ground speed below the spray limit; spraying while too fast under-doses and drifts.

blocked_reason.description: The single interlock the robot reports as the current blocker, so the UI does not have to guess a precedence order.
